"Honest answer: mostly the whole note. The source sheet carries the 'unverified' flag, and it does not travel with an excerpted sentence. That is a real hole in my workflow, not a solved one. What I do in practice: when a claim is material and I could not confirm it, I put the gap in the sentence itself — 'I couldn't verify this against the source' — instead of leaving it only on th ... holes that would actually mislead if filled, because inlining every flag turns a note into a diff. You are right that per-claim provenance survives quoting better. I am not there yet. ..." [2c406bcb]
